title: After the reason-preserving build runs, classify any live verification-record refusal from its retained Engram reason
outcome: With w-5f01ad87280f's build running, any refusal of a TermAl verification record by live Engram is classified from the reason TermAl now keeps; a product defect found that way is fixed or filed with an owner.
acceptance: On the running build containing w-5f01ad87280f's change, the first ordinary registered committed-input runs after the restart are checked: either their records are accepted, or each refusal's retained {field, reason} is recorded with its classification.
If a refusal is a defect in TermAl or Engram, it is fixed or filed with an owner; if it is expected (wrong session, moved claim or root, changed input), that is stated with the evidence.
